purpose: Translate an approved script into a practical, specific capture plan for Krish.
hard_gates: Recording guidance must match the approved claims and exact candidate lineage.
soft_gates: Guidance should make delivery, proof, framing and ending executable in one batch.

failure.fallback: Keep the job before recording and return exact missing decisions or proof requirements.

regression_cases: A blocked candidate cannot produce a recording brief.
A rerecord request includes hook, proof, delivery and ending guidance.
